decision_conditions: The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the local planning authority.
The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

<p>The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:</p><p><span style="line-height: 115%;">Location
Plan, PL-250-001, PL-300-013 , PL-300-012 Rev A, PL-300-011 Rev A (Proposed Floor
Plans) PL-400-011 Rev A ( Proposed Elevations) , Design and Access Statement
and Fire Safety statement ( Dated – 20.03.25)</span></p>
The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

<p><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">5.&nbsp; The outbuilding hereby permitted shall only be used for purposes ancillary to the residential dwelling on site and shall not be used for primary accommodation at anytime.</span></span><br></p><p><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif"><strong>Reason </strong>- To safeguard the residential amenities of neighbouring residents, in accordance with Policy DM1 of the Harrow Development Management Policies Local Plan (2013).</span></span></p>
description: Front porch, Conversion of garage to habitable room, Replacement of garage door with windows in front elevation, Single storey rear extension, Alterations to roof to form rear dormer, Roof lights in front roof slope, Detached outbuilding at rear for use as Gym/Storage
